title: Gateways

warnings.certExpiring: The certificate expires in {{ days }} days.
warnings.certExpiringSoon: The certificate expires in less than a day.
warnings.certExpired: The certificate has expired. The gateway can no longer connect.
warnings.crlExpiring: The revocation list expires soon. Renew it on your own computer (where the CA is) with “pki.sh crl” and distribute it with “broker-certs.sh”.

revokedHint: The gateway is revoked in the app. Now revoke its certificate too with “pki.sh revoke” and distribute the revocation list with “broker-certs.sh”; only then will the broker turn it away.

empty.title: No gateways yet
empty.description: You issue a gateway with “pki.sh” on your own computer (where the CA is); a platform administrator registers it here with its certificate. The steps are in the “Gateway” runbook.

register.title: Register a gateway
register.name: Name
register.nameError: Please enter a name of at most 60 characters.
register.certificateHint: The text of the certificate, including the BEGIN and END lines. Never paste the private key.
register.certificateError: Please paste the certificate (at most 20,000 characters).
register.privateKeyError: This looks like a private key and was not sent. Only the certificate (the public part) belongs here; the key stays on the gateway.
